notes: ASV margin offers 'chief prince of Meshech'; the printed rendering Rosh is what is aligned (rule 38).

s017 ʾēley carries the supplied copula of the prepositional predicate (rule 49), while the suffix on hinnēh keeps the subject pronoun I; the two explicit Gogs (s007, s019) take 'against Gog' and the vocative 'O Gog' respectively.
The suffix of ʾăḏōnāy (s013) is unrepresented, as throughout the chapter.
